messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Piper <elena@piper-consult.com>
Date: 2026-08-12T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Staged-launch: intake timeline, manager kit, and staged comms (draft)

Team —

I want to align on a staged approach for this year's annual review cycle that reduces last-minute exposures for sensitive roles while keeping timelines predictable for managers and ICs. Attached are two artifacts to start from: a one-page manager intake form (XLSX) and a comms draft for the staged launch (MD). Elena from Piper is copied with a checklist she suggested.

High-level proposal (short):
- Week 0 (Aug 24): Manager intake opens — managers submit promotion/role-change requests and sensitive-role flags via the attached intake form.
- Week 1–2 (Aug 31–Sep 11): Calibration + HR validation for flagged items. External audit checklist (Elena) applied where required.
- Week 3 (Sep 14–18): Manager communications wave 1 (non-sensitive roles).
- Week 4 (Sep 21–25): Staged comms for sensitive cohorts, manager 1:1 guidance, escalation channel open.

Needs / asks for this thread:
1) Confirm the intake fields are sufficient for managers — I attached the v1 form; please add any missing columns.
2) Approve the staged dates above — we can shift a week earlier if recruitment windows force it.
3) Decide whether to add a short dedicated hotline for managers during Week 4 (recommended for at-risk teams).

I want a concise manager-facing kit (templated talking points + email) and a secure handoff doc for HR. If you agree with the timeline, I will finalize the comms draft and route to legal for a brief read.

Thanks —
Olga
Director, People Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: manager_intake_form_v1.xlsx; staged_launch_comm_draft_v2.md

> High-level proposal (short):
> - Week 0 (Aug 24): Manager intake opens — managers submit promotion/role-change requests and sensitive-role flags via the attached intake form.
> - Week 1–2 (Aug 31–Sep 11): Calibration + HR validation for flagged items.

Agree with staged approach. Two quick operational notes:
- Can we compress Week 1 to 1 week (Aug 31–Sep 4) if the majority are non-sensitive? We can reserve the second week only for escalations. That reduces manager wait-time.
- I'm supportive of the hotline idea — propose coverage 10am–4pm PT for Week 4 with on-call rotation (2 people/day).

If compressed, suggest we shift final comms wave to Sep 21–23 (three-day window) to allow a short buffer.

Vivek

Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Staged-launch: intake timeline, manager kit, and staged comms (draft)

Thanks for looping me in, Olga. Attached is the confidential_review_checklist.pdf — a short checklist teams can use when a role is flagged as sensitive (legal implications, cross-team dependencies, data access considerations).

A few recommendations from an external ops/audit perspective:
- Add a mandatory "data access review" checkbox for any role handling PII or customer data.
- Attach a redaction guidance snippet in the manager kit for comms that must avoid operational details.
- For the hotline, require a short triage form so we can route true escalations to legal or security immediately.

I reviewed the intake form quickly — missing two suggested columns: "Primary data systems accessed" and "Proposed communication lead (name + email)". Happy to update and push a v1.1 if you want.

Elena Piper
Principal, Piper Consulting

Attachment: confidential_review_checklist.pdf
